_note: Machine-agnostic hooks tracked in git. Machine-specific hooks (e.g., the ComfyUI loader verification) live in settings.local.json which is gitignored.

hooks.command: bash -c 'input="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT:-}"; if echo "$input" | grep -qE "(^|/)uv\.lock\b"; then echo "[shrug hook] BLOCKED: uv.lock is machine-generated. Use uv sync / uv lock instead of editing it directly." >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$input" | grep -qE "templates/styles/[^/]+\.md"; then echo "[shrug hook] BLOCKED: templates/styles/*.md is a curated external set. Re-migrate from coderef/llm-dit-experiments/templates/z_image/ instead of hand-editing." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'
